```yaml
name: Issue Triage and Release Automation

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  triage-issue:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run issue triage script
        run: npm run triage-issue -- ${{ github.event.issue.number }}

  create-release-draft:
    needs: triage-issue
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Create release draft
        run: npm run create-release-draft

  announce-release:
    needs: create-release-draft
    if: github.event_name == 'release' && github.event.action == 'published'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Post to Discord
        uses: appleboy/discord-webhook-action@v1.7.2
        with:
          url: ${{ secrets.DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL }}
          content: |
            <@&123456789012345678> New release available: ${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}#${GITHUB_REF_NAME}

  review-pull-request:
    needs: triage-issue
    if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v2
      
      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'
      
      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install
      
      - name: Run PR review script
        run: npm run review-pr -- ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
```
